inspection_method: Original nine PNG views and an actual-render nine-view contact sheet; final RF and all four source-elevation overlays inspected. Sources P01 pp3–4 and P03 A02/A03/A07/A08–A11/A12/A14/A16–A19 were visually inspected before authoring.
observations: Complete main hall, curved irimoya upper slopes/lower hips and connected entry roof are visible.
Blank shallow rear projection; separate side decks and front/rear window ledge-rail groups, not a continuous veranda.
Right outer stair only, no invented left stair. Under-deck voids and open rail gaps remain visible.
Pale washed-stone walls, darker frames/louvers/glazing, grey roof and localized muted copper retained.
Door panels no longer intersect the intermediate pale wall band. All nine views use actual delivered geometry, with one documented Boolean section.
Whole-building views and roof view are framed without clipped architectural extrema; source dimensions are not distorted to fit renders.
limitations: Not calibrated true colour, exact tile/member counts or conservation-grade carving.
Long and short elevations disagree slightly on ornament height; simplified chiwen bounded by P01 p4 and long elevations, disclosed in README.
Ground-plan contains the closed display enclosure, not a reconstructed interior.
